## User scenario / 사용 상황

Who is trying to do what, and what is currently difficult?

## Proposed behavior / 원하는 동작

Describe the smallest useful improvement and how someone would verify it.

## Alternatives and scope / 대안과 범위

Mention existing workarounds and whether the change affects account permissions, the protocol, or deployment requirements.
